# Security Checklist: Multi-Tenant Auth Hardening

**Purpose**: Validate that the auth hardening specification is complete, clear, consistent, and ready for implementation
**Created**: 2026-07-02
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This checklist is generated by the `/speckit.checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.

## Requirement Completeness

- [x] CHK001 Are all core auth flows explicitly covered in requirements (login, refresh, logout, logout-all, switch-company, device sessions)? [Completeness, Spec §Goals; §API Contracts]
- [x] CHK002 Are all negative auth outcomes explicitly enumerated (invalid tenant, invalid credentials, locked user, expired token, reused token, unauthorized company)? [Completeness, Spec §Functional Requirements; §Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK003 Are the tenant/company/role/permission relationships documented for every entity that participates in access decisions? [Completeness, Spec §Tenant Isolation Requirements; §Key Entities]
- [x] CHK004 Are session metadata requirements complete enough to cover device views, current-session status, and recency tracking? [Completeness, Spec §Functional Requirements; §API Contracts]
- [x] CHK005 Are the non-goals explicit enough to bound the feature away from MFA, OAuth SSO, API keys, and admin CRUD? [Completeness, Spec §Non Goals]
- [x] CHK006 Are dependencies and assumptions complete for manual unlock operations, client support for refresh rotation, and existing tenant data? [Completeness, Spec §Dependencies; §Assumptions]

## Requirement Clarity

- [x] CHK007 Is "manual release by support/operations" defined clearly enough to avoid multiple interpretations? [Clarity, Spec §Clarifications; §FR-005]
- [x] CHK008 Is "generic security error" defined with enough precision to keep tenant, user, and token existence undisclosed? [Clarity, Spec §Security Requirements; §Functional Requirements]
- [x] CHK009 Is "within the same tenant" unambiguous for company switching and membership validation? [Clarity, Spec §FR-019; §Tenant Isolation Requirements]
- [x] CHK010 Is "session family" clearly defined as the refresh-token chain rather than a broader user session concept? [Clarity, Spec §FR-014; §Key Entities]
- [x] CHK011 Is `lastUsedAt` described clearly enough to indicate when it changes and how it is used in device views? [Clarity, Spec §API Contracts; data-model]
- [x] CHK012 Are the performance targets expressed with clear timing and percentile language rather than vague "fast" wording? [Clarity, Spec §Non-Functional Requirements]

## Requirement Consistency

- [x] CHK013 Do the spec, plan, and contracts use the same response shape for `/api/devices`? [Consistency, Spec §API Contracts; Plan; Contracts]
- [x] CHK014 Do login, refresh, and switch-company response requirements use one consistent auth envelope? [Consistency, Spec §API Contracts]
- [x] CHK015 Are permission-based access rules consistent across current and future protected endpoints? [Consistency, Spec §Security Requirements; §Goals]
- [x] CHK016 Are the manual unlock rules consistent with the decision not to add admin CRUD? [Consistency, Spec §Non Goals; §Clarifications]
- [x] CHK017 Are tenant isolation rules consistent between direct tenant-owned entities and parent-organization scoped company access? [Consistency, Spec §Tenant Isolation Requirements]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [x] CHK018 Are the success criteria measurable enough to be evaluated without implementation details? [Measurability, Spec §Success Criteria]
- [x] CHK019 Is the 50% support-ticket reduction target defined well enough to be compared against a baseline period? [Measurability, Spec §Success Criteria]
- [x] CHK020 Is the 100% cross-tenant denial target scoped clearly to the intended journeys and environments? [Measurability, Spec §Success Criteria]
- [x] CHK021 Is the 90% pilot-user success target specific about the pilot cohort and the tasks being measured? [Measurability, Spec §Success Criteria]
- [x] CHK022 Are the performance acceptance thresholds attached to the highest-risk auth journeys and not just listed generically? [Measurability, Spec §Non-Functional Requirements]

## Scenario Coverage

- [x] CHK023 Are primary, alternate, exception, and recovery scenarios covered for login, refresh, company switching, and session control? [Coverage, Spec §User Scenarios & Testing]
- [x] CHK024 Are zero-state and all-sessions-revoked scenarios covered for device/session listings? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases; §API Contracts]
- [x] CHK025 Are repeated failed login and locked-account retry scenarios covered in requirements? [Coverage, Spec §User Story 1; §Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK026 Are revoked-token reuse and expired-token recovery scenarios covered distinctly? [Coverage, Spec §User Story 2; §Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK027 Are cross-tenant access and unauthorized-company scenarios separated clearly enough to prevent overlap? [Coverage, Spec §User Story 3; §Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK028 Are inactive tenant, inactive company, and inactive organization states each addressed explicitly? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases; §Tenant Isolation Requirements]

## Edge Case Coverage

- [x] CHK029 Is behavior defined when a user has no default company assignment? [Gap, Spec §FR-011; §Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK030 Is behavior defined when a refresh token is malformed or missing? [Gap, Spec §API Contracts; §Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK031 Is behavior defined when session history is incomplete or `lastUsedAt` is unavailable? [Gap, Spec §API Contracts; data-model]
- [x] CHK032 Is rollback or partial-failure behavior defined for changes that affect lockout or token rotation? [Gap, Spec §Risks; §Functional Requirements]

## Non-Functional Requirements

- [x] CHK033 Are security requirements complete for secret handling, logging, and token storage? [Completeness, Spec §Security Requirements]
- [x] CHK034 Are observability requirements specific enough to preserve correlation and tenant context without exposing secrets? [Clarity, Spec §Security Requirements; Constitution]
- [x] CHK035 Are reliability or availability expectations defined for auth failures and recovery behavior? [Gap, Spec §Non-Functional Requirements]
- [x] CHK036 Are compliance or audit expectations for manual unlock and sensitive actions explicitly stated? [Gap, Spec §Dependencies; §Security Requirements]
- [x] CHK037 Are database and indexing expectations documented clearly enough to support the latency targets? [Coverage, Spec §Database Impact; Plan §Technical Context]

## Dependencies & Assumptions

- [x] CHK038 Are dependencies on existing tenant, company, role, permission, and membership data clearly documented? [Dependencies, Spec §Dependencies]
- [x] CHK039 Are assumptions about client support for refresh rotation and generic errors clearly stated? [Assumption, Spec §Assumptions; §Dependencies]
- [x] CHK040 Is the migration approach documented clearly enough to support rollout and rollback planning? [Gap, Plan §Technical Context; Constitution]
- [x] CHK041 Are the baseline SQL schema and future EF migration responsibilities separated clearly? [Consistency, Plan §Technical Context]
- [x] CHK042 Are future features (MFA, OAuth SSO, API keys, audit logging) explicitly excluded from the current scope? [Scope, Spec §Non Goals; §Assumptions]

## Ambiguities & Conflicts

- [x] CHK043 Does the spec resolve the tension between manual unlock only and preserving compatibility for locked users? [Conflict, Spec §Clarifications; §Goals]
- [x] CHK044 Are the terms access token, session, refresh token, and device session used consistently across spec, plan, and contracts? [Consistency, Spec §Key Entities; §API Contracts]
- [x] CHK045 Is the `AuthResponse` envelope intended for switch-company, or should the spec define a separate response contract? [Ambiguity, Spec §API Contracts]
- [x] CHK046 Is the controlled refresh-token query-filter bypass explicitly justified as an exception and not a general pattern? [Ambiguity, Plan §Constitution Check; Research]
- [x] CHK047 Is `lastUsedAt` mandatory in the requirements or only a planned data-model addition? [Ambiguity, Spec §API Contracts; data-model]
